record.question: The ambient air quality standard (24 hours average) for Sulphur Dioxide (SO2) in industrial/residential area is:
record.explanation: Held: the 24-hour SO2 standard applicable in 2019 was 80 µg/m³, equivalent to 0.080 mg/m³, under the 2009 National Ambient Air Quality Standards.
